name: Public Postsecondary Fall Enrollment: Summary
description: This dataset contains fall enrollment headcounts and percentages by race and gender. It includes undergraduate and graduate students at all public Massachusetts institutions of higher education since 2014. Data are disaggregated by the year of fall term, segment, institution, enrollment level, and enrollment status reporting counts and percentages of total enrollment by gender and race/ethnicity. This dataset is 1 of 2 datasets that is also published in the interactive Fall Enrollment dashboard on the Department of Higher Education Data Center: 1) Public Postsecondary Fall Enrollment: Detail 2) Public Postsecondary Fall Enrollment: Summary Related datasets: 1) Public Postsecondary Annual Enrollment: Detail 2) Public Postsecondary Annual Enrollment: Summary Notes: - Data appear as reported to the Massachusetts Department of Higher Education. - Figures published here may vary from those of individual institutions due to differences in calculation methodologies.
